tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports a smooth monotone-concave response but candidate mechanisms disagree, and the current rows do not discriminate an open branch contribution. Buy the cheaper targeted probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a stationary Haldane, Cobb–Douglas, or hydraulic-siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations at one horizon and fixed u_past, x_now, and mem_conv do not resolve the competing response shapes or any branch contribution well enough to trust fresh-forecast tolerance.
Costlier and broader than needed before testing the specifically suggested open-branch ambiguity.
Nuisance auxiliary data is irrelevant to the identified ambiguity and explicitly should not be purchased.
